decisions.reason: As a 2019 launch in a related industrial process niche, this product likely remains below fully validated aspiration levels but is close enough to the firm's capabilities that management would give it more time rather than redeploy resources immediately.

This hydrocyclone coolant filter appears closely aligned with the firm's core machinery and filtration business, so absent clear evidence of persistent underperformance, management would likely retain it while monitoring sales against aspiration levels.

The gravity band coolant filter is also a core-adjacent industrial offering, and with only ambiguous market evidence after launch, boundedly rational management would tend to keep it unless results clearly fell short of internal and peer-based aspirations.
